title: Personal Learning Data & Sensitive Files Ignore Contract
description: Canonical ignore patterns for sensitive personal learning data and third-party/regenerable files that must never be committed to a public repository.

patterns.description: Vega memory collection and review log (flashcard decks, scheduling state, FSRS intervals, private study ratings and history).
patterns.remediation: Untrack with 'git rm -r --cached .vega/' then commit; consider rewriting git history if pushed publicly.

patterns.description: Aurora learning events: quiz answers, predictions, recall outcomes, missed stations, and timestamps.
patterns.remediation: Untrack with 'git rm --cached **/progress.jsonl' then commit; check commit history if published.

patterns.description: Exported or dated Aurora learning progress event logs containing personal answers and scores.
patterns.remediation: Untrack with 'git rm --cached aurora-progress-*.jsonl' then commit; check history if published.

patterns.description: Orion attempt history with predictions, self-evaluation records, and learning attempts.
patterns.remediation: Untrack with 'git rm --cached orion-attempts.jsonl' then commit; check history if published.

patterns.description: Captured full-text web pages, PDFs, and video transcripts (copyrighted third-party sources and study copies).
patterns.remediation: Untrack with 'git rm -r --cached **/polaris/captures/' then commit; rewrite git history if copyrighted.

patterns.description: Cached search and API responses (OpenAlex, arXiv, CrossRef, etc.) which can be regenerated on demand.
